description: The single backend for claims, approvals, payroll exports and the people list. It owns every record in its database, writes an audit entry for each submission, decision and export, and builds the payroll CSV. It is one service because all three features share the same claims and run at the same scale; it holds no screens, stores no files, sends no email and does not issue tokens.
